accounts_normal_balance_matches_type.name: accounts_normal_balance_matches_type
accounts_normal_balance_matches_type.value: "accounts"."normal_balance" = case when "accounts"."type" in ('asset', 'expense') then 'debit'::normal_balance else 'credit'::normal_balance end

journal_entries_posted_complete.name: journal_entries_posted_complete
journal_entries_posted_complete.value: "journal_entries"."status" = 'draft' or ("journal_entries"."number" is not null and "journal_entries"."posted_at" is not null and "journal_entries"."period_id" is not null and "journal_entries"."idempotency_key" is not null)
